brief: Prior to the forecast heat event, review the open defect register for Northcott Bend to identify any outstanding work in categories one to three and complete it wherever crew capacity allows, as required by SOP-016. For this ONAN cooling unit facing an extended event with consecutive warm nights, apply any required ambient, reduced cooling, or sustained event loading reductions according to MG-021. Ensure continuous overnight operation of forced cooling where available, following MG-025, and record all applied de-ratings along with their reasons, values, and periods as specified in MG-021.
